description.value:
Duration while the duel lasts

Whatever they do about the wounds, they are still losing this at the rate you set.

Your marked target regains half as many Hit Points as it otherwise would from any source, and any persistent damage you have dealt it cannot be ended by anything short of magical healing of 6th rank or higher. It knows this is happening, which has never once made it easier for them.

cinderfall.incomplete: The mark regains only half as much HP from any source; persistent damage from the caster can't be ended below 6th-rank magical healing. No selector reduces a different creature's own healing receipt or raises the bar for ending their persistent damage, compounded by the confirmed-unfireable mark predicate.
